title: bug(console,docs): `line-chart` / `area-chart` / `advanced-chart` are lazy stubs `@object-ui/plugin-charts` never fulfils — the dashboard doc teaches one, and it paints OBJUI-001
body:
Filed unassigned by the `os-dev` seat while implementing objectui#8499 (session `session_01Jmxdo7bmeqCQHLSfmLVX9w`). Grading and `domain:*` are the triage seat's. Deliberately NOT repaired on #8499's PR: that card's remit is arms on `AnyComponentSchema` for renderers that already draw, and this is the opposite case — a key that resolves in the registry and draws nothing.

## The claim

`apps/console/src/register-plugins.ts:77` registers ten chart variants as LAZY STUBS pointing at `@object-ui/plugin-charts`:

```ts
for (const variant of ['object-chart', 'bar-chart', 'pie-chart', 'donut-chart', 'radar-chart',
                       'scatter-chart', 'line-chart', 'area-chart', 'advanced-chart', 'chart:bar']) {
  ComponentRegistry.registerLazy(variant, () => import('@object-ui/plugin-charts'), { namespace: 'plugin-charts', category: 'chart' });
}
```

`@object-ui/plugin-charts` registers **eight** keys, and three of that list are not among them. Derived from source at `origin/main` `3fbdd4a2d`, over `packages/plugin-charts/src/index.tsx` and `packages/plugin-charts/src/ObjectChart.tsx`:

| registered by the plugin | in the console's stub list | outcome |
|---|---|---|
| `bar-chart` `chart` `chart:bar` `donut-chart` `object-chart` `pie-chart` `radar-chart` `scatter-chart` | yes | resolves |
| — | `line-chart` `area-chart` `advanced-chart` | **stub resolves to nothing** |

`Registry.loadLazy`'s own docblock states the mechanism (`packages/core/src/registry/Registry.ts`):

> Trigger the lazy loader for `type`, if any. Resolves once the loader completes (**whether or not the loaded module actually registered the expected type** — caller should re-check the registry afterwards).

So the stub makes the key KNOWN — it enters `ComponentRegistry.getKnownTypes()` and therefore `check:doc-types`' derived 656-key universe — while nothing renders it. The renderer paints the registry's OBJUI-001 "Unknown component type" panel.

## The reader-facing half

`content/docs/plugins/plugin-dashboard.mdx:210` teaches it, inside a `card`'s `body` slot:

```json
{ "type": "card", "title": "Sales Trend",
  "body": { "type": "line-chart", "data": [], "height": 300 } }
```

A reader who copies that snippet gets the red panel. `check:doc-types` is GREEN on it, because the console's stub put the key in the registry it derives from — the same "a signal that reads clean because it never looked at the broken thing" shape objectui#8499's triage describes.

The repository has already recorded this failure once without a card of its own: `scripts/check-doc-component-types.mjs` calls a `plugin-detail` README defect "the registry's `OBJUI-001` panel, **the same failure as the `line-chart` widget** objectui#7896 recorded in `packages/plugin-dashboard/README.md`". objectui#7896 is about the gate's scan surface and does not own this.

## Two adjacent facts, so a repair does not stop half way

1. `packages/cli/src/utils/known-schema-types.ts` carries `line-chart` (`:234`) and `plugin-charts:line-chart` (`:302`) — it is generated from the same registrations, so the CLI's vocabulary inherits the phantom.
2. `CHART_TYPE_KEYWORD_FAMILIES` (`packages/plugin-charts/src/normalizeChartSchema.ts`) deliberately holds only the five keywords the plugin registers to `ChartRenderer`, and `__tests__/chart-family-from-type-7401.test.tsx` pins it against the live registry in both directions. That pin cannot see this defect: it walks what the PLUGIN registered, never what the CONSOLE promised.

## Reproduction

`ComponentRegistry.get('line-chart')` after `await import('@object-ui/plugin-charts')` is `undefined`, while `ComponentRegistry.get('pie-chart')` is `ChartRenderer` — the same probe, one control each way. Source-level probe, run on `claude/issue-8499-node-slot-unresolved-arms`:

```
registered by packages/plugin-charts/src/index.tsx: bar-chart chart chart:bar donut-chart pie-chart radar-chart scatter-chart
contains 'pie-chart'  : true      (control — the reader is not blind)
contains 'line-chart' : false
```

## Two routes, neither chosen here

- **(a) register them.** `advanced-chart` and `area-chart` plausibly want `ChartRenderer` with a family entry; `line-chart` would need `CHART_TYPE_KEYWORD_FAMILIES` to gain a `line` row, and `RENDERABLE`'s vocabulary decides whether that is even a family.
- **(b) drop the three from the console's stub list** and correct the doc snippet to a keyword that draws.

They differ in what the docs then teach, so the choice is not mechanical.
